name: nomess
description: Keeps AI-written code from turning into a mess: commit-time checks, path-scoped lessons, a generated system map, a design-first workflow and reviews

python.title: Python command
python.description: Command the hooks use to run scripts. macOS / Linux: python3; Windows: python, or py if only py is installed. Change it in /config if wrong.

auto_init.title: Auto-enable nomess
auto_init.description: Enable nomess automatically in a new project before the first file change.
